Eliza (People Ops): Trying a different angle: a micro OKR + mentorship card that explicitly captures growth signals, benefits/coverage planning, and a line managers can paste into hiring notes. Needs to be tiny.
Marco T: Nice. Please include one short development handshake line so managers and ICs agree on mentorship time upfront.
Nadia S: Also add a one-liner to flag benefits implications (parental leave, FMLA coverage) so people ops sees it during cycles.
Rohan B: Can we include a short self-review prompt that prompts evidence + metric so peers can give useful feedback?
Eliza (People Ops): Draft below. It's intended to be 6 lines max per goal and copy/paste friendly into calendar notes or PRs.
Eliza (People Ops): ```
GOAL (one line + metric): "Increase embedding recall by 8% for 90d queries"
Why (one line): customer impact or risk reduction
Sprint commits: 1-2 actions (owner + ETA) | Mentorship: 0.5-1hr/wk (handshake: mentor + cadence)
Confidence: 1-5 | Blockers & deps (owner + ETA) | Coverage plan: owner + dates (benefits/PTO note)
Ask: decision / access / hiring signal (one line for requisition)
Self-review prompt: "What I shipped, the signal/metric, and one improvement I'd make"
```
Marco T: Love the mentorship handshake line. Helps set expectations before the quarter.
Nadia S: The coverage + benefits tag is perfect. Suggest adding a short privacy note: "private calibration only" for leveling comments.
Rohan B: For hiring signal, sample text: "May need backend SRE for perf work; consider senior IC comp profile." keeps recruiter alignment fast.
Eliza (People Ops): I'll add a tiny calibration blurb managers can paste into private docs: Outcome / Signals / Level suggestion. Final step: pilot in two teams and collect one quick template edit.
GrowthBot: Tip: paste the self-review prompt in the peer feedback thread to get structured replies.
Marco T: I'll pilot with my growth squad and report back next week.
Eliza (People Ops): Thanks all — I'll finalize and publish in the performance kickoff doc. Ping me if you want a 10m setup call to pre-fill templates. :rocket:
